description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git diff operations on symlinks, including creating, comparing, and manipulating symlinks and files within a Git repository. It defines functions for obtaining object IDs and runs a series of tests to verify diff behavior with symlinks.

methods.name: symlink_oid
methods.description: Prints the short object ID of a symlink with the given name by hashing the name and parsing the short hash.

methods.name: short_oid
methods.description: Prints the short object ID of a given file by hashing the file and parsing the short hash.
